title: Generalized Optimal Subpattern Assignment Metric
text: Calculate Generalized Optimal Subpattern Assignment Metric, 3 inputs, 6 outputs, {Distance type} sets Distance type; {Cutoff distance} sets the threshold for cutoff distance between track, {Order}, {Alpha}, {Custom distance function}, {Motion model} sets the desired platform motion, {Switching penalty} sets the penalty for assignment switching, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Assignments} enables assignment input, {GOSPA metric without switching error}, {Switching error} enables switching error component output, {Localization error} enables localization error component output, {Missed target error} enables missed target error component, {False track error} enables false track error component output, {Track bus}, {Truth bus}, {Track extractor function} and {Truth extractor function}. Values come from the instance.
